name: M-Kopa
evidence: M-KOPA's own contact page gives its South African office address as The Campus, Twickenham Block C, corner Main and Sloane Street, Bryanston, Johannesburg, 2021.
note_append: M-KOPA now describes itself as a smartphone and digital-finance business across five markets, not only as a solar home-systems company; the taxonomy placement at residential solar understates the current business and the financing side is the larger part of it. The South African office in Bryanston is recorded; the group is headquartered in Kenya, and M-KOPA's own contact page lists offices in Ghana, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Uganda and the United Kingdom without naming a group headquarters.
